summary.answer:
**Houston TX shipped the most revenue to customers outside its own country in 2023: about $108.3K in net revenue.** All 10 distribution centers are in the US, so "outside its own country" here means customers whose country isn't the United States.

| Rank | Distribution center | Net revenue | Gross revenue | Net items |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | **Houston TX** | **$108.3K** | $139.4K | 1,528 |
| 2 | Memphis TN | $86.9K | $116.6K | 1,535 |
| 3 | Chicago IL | $86.3K | $117.2K | 1,550 |
| 4 | Mobile AL | $79.8K | $101.3K | 1,192 |
| 5 | Philadelphia PA | $66.4K | $86.3K | 1,030 |
| … | Charleston SC (last) | $43.2K | $57.6K | 1,055 |

**Why Houston leads:** it shipped about the same number of items as Memphis and Chicago (around 1,530 each) but earned about $21K (25%) more. The gap comes from higher-priced items, not more of them: about $71 per item, against roughly $56–57 at Memphis and Chicago.

**How this was measured:**
- **Revenue:** net revenue, which leaves out cancelled and returned items. Houston also leads on gross revenue (all items, any status), so the definition doesn't change the answer.
- **Time period:** items ordered in calendar 2023 (UTC), dated by when each item was ordered.
- **Which DC an item counts toward:** the warehouse its product is assigned to ship from.

**Confidence:** high. Houston's lead is large under both revenue definitions.

**Caveats:**
- The data is synthetic.
- Each product is tied to one warehouse, so this shows where items were assigned to ship from, not tracked shipments.
- Spelling variants of country names (Deutschland, España, Brasil) don't matter here, because the only test is whether the country is the US.

run.prompt: Which distribution center ships the most revenue to customers outside its own country in 2023?

input.sql:
SELECT dc.name,
 SUM(IF(oi.status NOT IN ('Cancelled','Returned'), oi.sale_price, 0)) net_rev,
 SUM(oi.sale_price) gross_rev,
 COUNTIF(oi.status NOT IN ('Cancelled','Returned')) net_items
FROM `bigquery-public-data.thelook_ecommerce.order_items` oi
JOIN `bigquery-public-data.thelook_ecommerce.users` u ON oi.user_id=u.id
JOIN `bigquery-public-data.thelook_ecommerce.products` p ON oi.product_id=p.id
JOIN `bigquery-public-data.thelook_ecommerce.distribution_centers` dc ON p.distribution_center_id=dc.id
WHERE oi.created_at>='2023-01-01' AND oi.created_at<'2024-01-01' AND u.country!='United States'
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY net_rev DESC

SELECT dc.name,
 SUM(IF(oi.status NOT IN ('Cancelled','Returned'), oi.sale_price, 0)) net_rev,
 SUM(oi.sale_price) gross_rev,
 COUNTIF(oi.status NOT IN ('Cancelled','Returned')) net_items
FROM `bigquery-public-data.thelook_ecommerce.order_items` oi
JOIN `bigquery-public-data.thelook_ecommerce.users` u ON oi.user_id=u.id
JOIN `bigquery-public-data.thelook_ecommerce.products` p ON oi.product_id=p.id
JOIN `bigquery-public-data.thelook_ecommerce.distribution_centers` dc ON p.distribution_center_id=dc.id
WHERE oi.created_at>='2023-01-01' AND oi.created_at<'2024-01-01' AND u.country!='United States'
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY net_rev DESC
